soldier.name: Brace & Dig In
soldier.desc: Drop low and set your feet: +2 armor until your next turn. Builds 2 TP.

soldier.name: Steady Aim
soldier.desc: Settle your breathing and line up the next shot: your next normal attack this round gets +2 TN. Builds 1 TP.

soldier.name: Dig In & Push
soldier.desc: Break from cover: move up to your squares, then fire at an enemy in sight for weapon damage.

soldier.name: Suppressive Sweep
soldier.desc: Pinning fire: one enemy, or two adjacent to each other, attack at −4 TN until the end of next round.

soldier.name: Overwatch Sweep
soldier.desc: Hold two lines of sight: a free shot at +2 TN on the first enemy that crosses each, before your next turn.

soldier.name: Commanding Directive
soldier.desc: Bark an order: an ally in sight takes one free action right now (move or attack).

soldier.name: Coordinated Crossfire
soldier.desc: Mark a target: until the end of the round, allies attacking it get +2 TN and +1d6 damage.

soldier.name: Tactical Redeployment
soldier.desc: Every ally may move up to their squares without provoking opportunity attacks; allies who end in cover get +2 armor until their next turn.

soldier.name: Fix Bayonets / Charge
soldier.desc: Charge up to your squares into an enemy and strike: weapon damage +1d6, and the target is Prone.

soldier.name: Bunker Buster
soldier.desc: A brutal point-blank blow or shot: weapon damage that ignores half the target's armor, and cracks its armor by 1.

soldier.name: Reckless Execution
soldier.desc: Empty the magazine at point blank: roll weapon damage twice (melee: two strikes). Needs at least 3 rounds loaded.

hacker.name: Ping Sweep
hacker.desc: Map the local network: reveal hidden units and devices within 10 squares, through walls. Until the end of the round, allies get +2 TN against revealed targets.

hacker.name: Credentials Spoof
hacker.desc: Forge a high-clearance ID for you and one ally: synthetic systems (turrets, drones, doors) ignore you both, and organic guards accept you as authorised. Ends if either of you attacks.

hacker.name: Keylogger Injection
hacker.desc: Bug a cybernetic or synthetic target: the GM announces its next action before it acts. Each time it acts, you vent 1 heat.

hacker.name: Thermal Dump
hacker.desc: Safe venting cycle: vent 3 heat. No offensive hacks for the rest of this turn. No roll.

hacker.name: Data Loop / Strobe
hacker.desc: Loop a strobe into the optics of a cybernetic or synthetic target: it attacks at −4 TN.

hacker.name: Feedback Loop (DDoS)
hacker.desc: Overload a target’s circuits: 3d6 damage to a synthetic target, 2d6 to a cybernetic one, ignoring armor. No effect on organic targets.

hacker.name: Overclock Pulse
hacker.desc: Push the deck past safe limits: your next instant hack this round hits two targets, or the same target twice.

hacker.name: Release Payload
hacker.desc: End all your sustained hacks and free their RAM. To end just one, tap its ✕ on the deck panel. No roll.

hacker.name: System Hard Reboot
hacker.desc: Emergency restart: clear all RAM and heat, but the deck stays offline for the rest of this round and the next. No roll.

hacker.name: Logic Bomb
hacker.desc: Plant a dormant payload in a cybernetic or synthetic target. When it moves, or when you release it, it detonates: 3d6 damage to the target and 1d6 to anyone adjacent.

hacker.name: False Flag Broadcast
hacker.desc: Spoof a friendly-fire alert: a cybernetic or synthetic enemy spends its next turn attacking its nearest ally.

techwiz.name: Scavenge & Survey
techwiz.mend: Reveal cover and hazards within 6 squares; one ally gets +2 TN on their next Avoid / Reflexes roll.
techwiz.surge: Mark a weak point on an enemy in sight: the next hit against it ignores 2 armor.

techwiz.name: Field Maintenance
techwiz.mend: Mend 2 cracks in an adjacent ally’s armor.
techwiz.surge: Crack an adjacent enemy’s armor by 2, or deal 1d6 to an adjacent drone.

techwiz.name: Improvised Cover
techwiz.mend: Raise Partial cover (+2) in a square next to an ally, until it is moved or destroyed.
techwiz.surge: Hurl the scrap plate: 2d6 to one enemy in sight.

techwiz.name: Targeted Overclock
techwiz.mend: An ally in sight gets +1 action next round.
techwiz.surge: An ally's next weapon hit deals +1d6.

techwiz.name: Restock & Repair
techwiz.mend: Fabricate 1 Tool Kit from scrap, or fully repair a drone or turret.
techwiz.surge: Salvage a wreck in reach: every ally reloads one weapon for free.

techwiz.name: Fortify Position
techwiz.mend: A cover piece becomes Full cover (+4) until the end of next round.
techwiz.surge: Electrify a cover piece: an enemy in or next to it takes 1d6 and is Stunned.

techwiz.name: Rig Power Conduit
techwiz.mend: Adjacent allies get +2 armor until the end of next round.
techwiz.surge: A 2×2 shock zone for 3 rounds: 1d6 to anyone ending a turn inside; drones in it are Disconnected.

techwiz.name: Healing Surge
techwiz.mend: Heal an adjacent ally 2d6 HP, or stabilise someone at 0 HP without a roll.
techwiz.surge: Corrosive injection at melee range: the target is Poisoned / Corroded.

techwiz.name: Deploy Sentry
techwiz.mend: A barrier drone gives Partial cover (+2) to allies in a 2×2 area behind it.
techwiz.surge: A sentry turret (HP 8, armor 1) fires at the nearest enemy at each round end: TN 10, 1d6.

techwiz.name: Structural Collapse
techwiz.mend: Brace the structure: pillars give the whole squad Full cover (+4) until destroyed.
techwiz.surge: Bring the ceiling down on a 3×3 area: 3d6, cover there is destroyed, targets are Prone.

smuggler.name: Street Snap-Shot
smuggler.desc: Fire your readied gun (weapon damage, 1 round), then move up to 2 squares into cover.

smuggler.name: Bribe / Distraction
smuggler.desc: Toss credits or contraband: an organic enemy in sight attacks at −4 TN on its next attack.

smuggler.name: Pistol Whip & Rob
smuggler.desc: Strike an adjacent enemy for weapon damage without using ammo, and take one magazine or item from them (the GM says what).

smuggler.name: Adrenaline Rush
smuggler.desc: Sprint up to twice your squares without provoking attacks of opportunity.

smuggler.name: Contraband Stash
smuggler.desc: Pull something from a hidden pocket. Pick one: heal 1d6 HP; +2 armor until the end of next round; or smoke (2×2 area, attacks through it at −4 TN).

smuggler.name: Safehouse Route
smuggler.desc: Guide an ally in sight through an unmonitored path: they move up to their squares without provoking attacks and lose Prone or Stunned.

smuggler.name: Decoy Deployment
smuggler.desc: Place a decoy within 5 squares. Until it is destroyed (1 hit) or the next round ends, enemies who can see it attack it first.

smuggler.name: Black-Market Ammo
smuggler.desc: Load special rounds into your readied gun. Until your next reload, pick one: its shots ignore half armor, or deal +1d6 damage.

smuggler.name: Desperate Gamble
smuggler.desc: Un-aimed full-auto sweep: weapon damage, rolled once, to every enemy in a 3×3 area. Needs 3+ rounds loaded and empties the magazine; your nerve crashes to −3.

smuggler.name: Call in Favor
smuggler.desc: Outdoors or in an unshielded zone, once per combat. At the start of next round, pick one: a sniper round (3d6 to one target, ignoring armor) or a flare (2d6 to everyone in a 3×3 area).
